sections.title: ATHA brings education, research, industry, talent, experience design and AI-nati
sections.text: ATHA’s vision is a world where AI-native innovation creates extraordinary business and societal value while making work healthier, more joyful, more responsible and more human. Its mission is to develop future changemakers and demonstrate that outstanding innovation and human flourishing can strengthen one another.

sections.title: ATHA exists to create AI-native innovation experiences that connect people, orga
sections.text: ATHA’s mission is to create and operate AI-native innovation experiences and a global ecosystem through which people and organisations can work on real industry challenges, understand AI holistically, make better decisions about its use, experience healthier ways of working and develop capabilities for the AI-native era.

sections.title: As a challenge partner, you receive a designed experience, assessment, talent ac
sections.text: An industry partner pays ATHA for the designed experience, the challenge assessment, access to talent and research, challenge-specific outputs, ecosystem membership, future ATHA access and continuing relationships. The partner owns its challenge-specific results, concepts, prototypes and newly created intellectual property.

sections.title: Warwick Business School provides the academic environment, knowledge, participan
sections.text: Warwick Business School’s role in ATHA is as partner and co-host, contributing academic environment, knowledge, participants, research, network and institutional standards to the experience.

sections.title: The first ATHA edition is taking shape with around 45 participants, nine teams a
sections.text: Around 45 selected participants will form nine multidisciplinary teams of five to tackle three real enterprise AI challenges, with three independent teams per challenge, based at Warwick/Coventry for a multi-day working experience at Warwick Business School.

sections.title: Every ATHA edition follows a seven-stage arc from arrival to integration.
sections.text: Participants arrive and settle, then open and sense the challenge before connecting across disciplines to create through AI-native investigation. They discern evidence and consequences, celebrate shared excellence, and integrate insights to carry into the next edition.

stages.name: Arrive & Settle
stages.description: People are met rather than processed; the room is made, not booked.

stages.name: Open & Sense
stages.description: The question is opened before it is attacked, presented as it actually sits.

stages.name: Connect
stages.description: Teams form across disciplines, around the question.

stages.name: Create
stages.description: The longest stage: AI-native investigation, AI used fully, never accepted blindly.

stages.name: Discern
stages.description: Evidence, consequences, uncertainty, trade-offs — given more room than any stage except the work itself.

stages.name: Celebrate
stages.description: Recognition is shared rather than ranked; different forms of excellence, no overall winner.

stages.name: Integrate & Return
stages.description: Leave with something integrated; the relationships carry into the next edition.

sections.title: OneMundi initiates and owns ATHA while Warwick Business School co-hosts as acade
sections.text: OneMundi is the initiator and owner of ATHA, providing enterprise transformation, the AI-native methodology, the commercial model and the continuing ecosystem. Warwick Business School is the partner and co-host, supplying the academic environment, knowledge, participants, research and institutional standards.

layers.name: OneMundi
layers.description: Initiator and owner. Enterprise transformation, the AI-native methodology, the commercial model, the independence of the verdict, and the ecosystem that continues between editions.
